title: Where Is Mom?
subtitle: Henry follows familiar clues and keeps Leo close.

levels.title: Crumbs at the Gate
levels.clue: The brothers followed snack crumbs too far—and now they cannot see Mom.

levels.title: Mom's Pink Slipper
levels.clue: Match beside the leafy patches. Henry smells something familiar underneath.

levels.title: Keys in the Flowers
levels.clue: A tiny jingle! Henry searches the flowers while Leo stays close.

levels.title: Which Way, Henry?
levels.clue: Henry chooses the gentle path and makes sure Leo follows.

levels.title: Leaves over the Path
levels.clue: Some clues are tucked beneath two layers of leaves.

levels.title: Leo Starts to Worry
levels.clue: Henry gathers comforting signs of home and stays beside Leo.

levels.title: Familiar Footsteps
levels.clue: Slipper, keys, pawprints—every clue says they are heading home.

levels.title: The Porch Light
levels.clue: Henry spots the porch light and leads Leo toward it one pawstep at a time.

levels.title: Almost Home
levels.clue: The cottage is close. Find the final familiar signs along the path.

levels.title: There You Are, Mom!
levels.clue: Henry follows every clue until Leo sees Mom waiting in the warm window.
